craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 52. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 10. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Detail, terrible form and, runs on earth and downwards; or crow-etc unheard sound: then him the guru should mark.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vistaro ghorarūpaśca mahīṃ dhāvati cāpyadhaḥ dhvāṃkṣādyaśravyaśabdo vā tadā taṃ lakṣayedguruḥ
